author: sky.cactus
content: <@459548743402913793> There is a *huge* amount of spam on GitHub from people who just tell their AI, "go find something useful to change in this repository".  AI is good enough that it will find *something*, but this technique generates a massive volume of garbage that massively overloads reviewers.  If you want to not get banned, take steps to not look like people who are doing that.
